purpose: Quality contract for all Grade 7 lessons
rules: Preserve every source teaching point, vocabulary item, activity and assessment item.
Enrich presentation and pedagogy when it improves learning without changing the curriculum target.
Never invent unsupported curriculum facts and never silently omit source content.
Grammar and conversation may be pedagogically enriched from the lesson objective and source language, while remaining level-appropriate.
Adapt the interaction pattern to the nature of each lesson rather than forcing identical content into every section.

journey.vocabulary: complete source vocabulary plus visual/contextual interaction
journey.pronunciation: source pronunciation targets plus listen-repeat discrimination practice
journey.grammar: source-grounded explanation, guided examples, progressive practice and error feedback
journey.conversation: natural level-appropriate dialogue using lesson language, listen/choose/complete/role-play
journey.practice: source activities plus additional graduated practice
journey.video: use source video/assets when present; never fabricate unavailable media
journey.games: short skill-aligned games tied to lesson objectives
journey.smart-review: adaptive review driven by mistakes and mastery, cumulative across lessons
journey.assessment: official source assessment preserved, with clearly separated enrichment questions where useful
journey.progress: mastery by skill, completion state and targeted retry path

masteryModel.completionRequires: meaningful interaction and assessment, not page opening alone
masteryModel.display: skill-level mastery plus overall lesson mastery
